annotations.description: About 1.5 request(s) to /api/orders/{order_id} returned a 5xx status in the last 5 minutes.

timeline.note: firing alert Order Tracker 5xx responses for /api/orders/{order_id}
3 error logs, 1 error traces, failing paths ['/api/orders/express-1002']
failing paths no longer return 5xx; fix awaits human review

answer.root_cause: order_detail computed express delivery with placed_at.replace(day=placed_at.day + 2), which raises ValueError for orders placed in the last two days of a month (seeded express-1002 is dated at the previous month's end).
answer.fix: app/main.py - use placed_at + timedelta(days=2); tests/test_api.py - added month-end express regression test and seeded express-1002 endpoint test
answer.verification: uv run --frozen pytest -q -> 28 passed; incident-response/runbooks/redeploy.sh -> container healthy; incident-response/runbooks/verify-recovery.sh /api/orders/express-1002 -> 3/3 200, RECOVERED
answer.result: Fixed month-end date overflow in express delivery estimate; GET /api/orders/{order_id} recovered, diff awaiting human review.
